Sunset Dunes 位于 Lincoln Way 与 Sloat Boul: Sunset Dunes runs between Lincoln Way and Sloat Boulevard, with public art, recreation spaces, and ocean-view seating listed by the city. A temporary restroom is at Noriega. Treat the ocean as a backdrop for a relaxed walk; the two-mile length is not a required route, and performances are not guaranteed every day in October.
集合时把路口写成 Noriega Street 与海滨公园交会处，先找好卫生间和: Meet where Noriega Street reaches the oceanfront park. Find the restroom and return route before choosing north or south.
走 20–30 分钟后停一次：各选一件喜欢的公共艺术，或者找一张座椅看海。带儿童: Pause after 20–30 minutes to choose a favorite artwork or watch the ocean from a seat. With children, separate active riding from quiet observation.
